messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: gpu-pool-autoscale alert triggered. metric: custom/gpu_utilization >= 95% for 4m. Severity: P0. Paging: kevin, maria.

maria: I'm awake, joining. what's the scope?

kevin: seeing rapid queue growth on realtime-inferer: queue depth jumped 80 -> 2200 in ~18m, 503/429s at the edge. HPA hasn't created new replicas — custom metrics missing.

anya: I grabbed logs from prometheus-adapter: repeated errors: 
```
E0421 12:04:12.123 promadapter.go:142] fetchCustomMetrics: upstream request failed: context deadline exceeded
E0421 12:04:12.123 promadapter.go:153] requeueing metric target: namespace=ml, name=gpu-util
```

devon: metrics-server also has OOMKilled recently on node prometheus-2; cluster autoscaler has been constrained by pod priority, maybe delayed node provisioning.

maria: customers are reporting degraded throughput. can we do any quick customer-facing mitigations (fallback routing, reduce concurrency)?
\
devon: current nodepool has 6 nodes, 2 already at 100% mem. If we bump replicas without adding nodes we'll push OOMs. Need nodegroup scale first.

kevin: agree. I'll request cloud nodepool scale: gcloud container clusters resize prod --node-pool=gpu-rt --num-nodes=18 (from 6).

ops-bot: Command queued: gcloud resize by kevin at 1766600070

anya: routing change ready. lowering route weight for label tier=best-effort from 1.0 -> 0.0, fallback to model-size=small. Applying now.

maria: do it and post to #support. Include expected impact on quality and ETA 30m.

anya: routing change applied. snippet: 
```
PATCH /routes/realtime
{"match":{"tenant_tier":"best-effort"},"backend":"realtime-small","weight":1.0}
```

kevin: nodepool resize in progress. cloud console shows new nodes provisioning (18 requested). watch kubelet join.

devon: prometheus-adapter pods are coming back but showing degraded scrape lag metrics. adapter logs show some 500s from Prometheus: "read tcp: connection reset by peer" - looks like Prometheus side disk IO contention during retention compaction.

maria: are any customers at risk of data loss? this is inference traffic only. priority tenants first.

kevin: traffic routing worked: best-effort load dropped ~60%. queue growth slowed. 429s decreased by ~50%. but some paid tenants still seeing higher tails due to backend token competition.

ops-bot: New event: node gpu-rt-12 joined cluster at 1766600215

anya: HPA still not scaling automatically. once adapter reads the custom metrics HPA should resume. watching adapter -> metrics-server -> HPA chain.

kevin: investigating prom retention config changed earlier today by infra: scrape retention reduced, but compaction CPU spike took Prometheus node to 95% causing read latency. I'll roll back retention tweak after mitigation.

devon: manual scale of K8s Deployment for realtime replicas to 12 to relieve queue while autoscaler recovers. Command: kubectl scale deploy/realtime-inferer -n prod --replicas=12

maria: do manual scale + set alert suppressors for HPA to avoid flapping when metrics reappear.

kevin: confirmed: metrics flow restored. prometheus-adapter emitting custom metrics again. HPA observed and triggering scale based on pods_per_gpu metric.

anya: scaling activity: replicas increased from 4 -> 12, new pods scheduling to newly provisioned nodes. queue depth falling: 2200 -> 420 in 14m.

maria: support update sent. Customers notified: recovery measures applied, ETA 15-30m, prioritized tenants will be routed back to full models as capacity frees.

devon: monitoring: GPU utilization trending down to 70%, node memory stable. no further OOMs.

kevin: mitigation summary (to paste in incident playbook):
- root symptom: HPA didn't react, queue grew -> customer errors.
- proximate cause: Prometheus read latency during compaction after retention change caused prometheus-adapter timeouts -> custom metrics unavailable to HPA.
- live mitigations: routing best-effort -> small model (1766600035), restart prometheus-adapter (1766600025), nodepool scale request (1766600070), manual deployment scale (1766600150).

maria: preparing handoff. oncall shift in 18m. devon, kevin, anya create follow-ups and schedule postmortem. I'll stay until handoff.

anya: created tickets: INFRA-1242 (revert retention tweak + safe rollout), SRE-980 (adapter retry backoff), ENG-4421 (routing runbook + automation).

devon: I'll add playbook steps for manual nodepool scale and K8s deploy scale in the runbook.

maria: final check: last 10m no 429s, queue stable at ~150, GPUs 60-72% utilization. marking mitigated. will post incident summary and link follow-ups. great coordination folks. :white_check_mark:
